note: The concentration report. It reads the hidden tab Concentration.Exposure and the Holdings tab. Every cell is a label, a formula, the threshold cell B23, or the overlap minimum cell B24. B1 holds the disclaimer. B4 counts the holdings that are funds not looked through. B9 and B10 read the run-time block A16:B25 of Concentration.Exposure. B12 holds the coverage label of the measures. The section Holdings, the header row of the holdings chart, the band of 26 blank rows in which the holdings chart sits, the note on trusts, the header of the company table, the company table, the header row of the company chart with the threshold, the band of 26 blank rows in which the company chart sits, the fund overlap list, the section of the funds not looked through, the section of the other holdings, and the total are one spill from A26.

values: This report is intended for informational purposes only. It does not constitute investment advice. The presented data might be inaccurate, incomplete, or out of date.
Securities by company, with a look inside each fund.
A fund that holds other funds uses the newest report of each held fund. The date of a held report can differ from the date in this table.
